description: One-time In Loans compact details layout. Apply only to the original 111-column sheet with Param in J; the result has 113 columns and Param in L.
prerequisite: Deploy the header-based timeline lookup in RepaymentCalculations.js before applying.
repaymentStatus: Forecast month-end checks: late interest means interest has not started by its start month, or remains at maturity; late principal means principal remains at maturity. Interest lateness takes precedence.
